name: zc_avatar_hitch

detail.note: a hitch is one frame; sampled every tick rather than on an interval, or the frame that stutters is the one the sampler slept through

tests.name: an arriving avatar does not add a hitch worse than the 73 ms the founder still felt

detail.note: the longest frame during a spawn against a NORMAL frame in the same session, so neither the machine's own stalls nor its thermal state is charged to the avatar
